subject: general
question: Who among the following is elected in the Municipal Corporation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Councillor**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Councillor** is the elected representative in the Municipal Corporation.
 
• The Municipal Corporation is the local governing body of a city or town, responsible for civic administration and infrastructure.
 
• Councillors are elected by the residents of the municipal area through municipal elections.
 
• The role of a councillor includes representing the interests of their constituents, making policy decisions, and overseeing the delivery of local services.
 
• Other roles in the Municipal Corporation such as **Security staff, Administrative staff, and Commissioner** are appointed positions, not elected.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Municipal Corporation is governed by the **Municipal Act** or the respective state legislation that outlines its powers, functions, and responsibilities.
 
• The head of the Municipal Corporation is usually the Mayor, who may be elected directly by the public or by the elected councillors.
 
• Councillors play a crucial role in local governance, ensuring that the needs and concerns of the community are addressed.
 
• Municipal elections are typically held every five years, and the number of councillors varies depending on the size and population of the municipal area.
 
• The Municipal Corporation is responsible for services such as water supply, waste management, public health, and urban planning.
